text:
Went here for a teeth cleaning. All went well, I was lucky that a previous appointment finished earlier and I was seen immediately.
Steps:
1. Examination and quote. Their range is 900-2000 Baht, I was quoted 1000, which seems reasonable as I brush frequently
2. Remove plaque and tartar
3. Polishing

Couple of small things that could be improved:
No flossing at the end of the sessions.
Step 2 finished really quick in comparison to my usual sessions in the UK (which cost 6,000 Baht),   and it felt less intense. The reason could be my new toothbrush (great!) or the limit of their equiment.

Nothing major that would void a 5 star rating, I would go here again.
